#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

bool isAlpha(char ch) {
    return (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z') || (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z');
}

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> n >> s;

    int maxSequence = -1;
    int currentCount = 0;
    int totalNumbers = 0;
    bool insideParentheses = false;
    int sequenceLength = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char c = s[i];
        if (!insideParentheses) {
            if (isAlpha(c)) {
                currentCount++;
            }
            if (currentCount > 0 && (c == '_' || c == '(')) {
                maxSequence = std::max(maxSequence, currentCount);
                currentCount = 0;
            }
        } else {
            if (isAlpha(c)) {
                sequenceLength++;
            }
            if (c == '_' || c == ')') {
                if (sequenceLength > 0) {
                    totalNumbers++;
                    sequenceLength = 0;
                }
                if (c == ')') {
                    insideParentheses = false;
                }
            }
        }
        if (c == '(') {
            insideParentheses = true;
        }
    }
    if (currentCount > 0) {
        maxSequence = std::max(maxSequence, currentCount);
    }
    if (maxSequence == -1) {
        std::cout << 0 << " ";
    } else {
        std::cout << maxSequence << " ";
    }
    std::cout << totalNumbers << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
